newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Mediaset reconfirms three MDs.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Mediaset reconfirms three MDs.

text.p: Italian broadcasting and advertising group Mediaset reconfirmed Carlo Bernasconi, Giuliano Adreani and Adriano Galliani as its three managing directors.
As expected, the board of Mediaset, which is part of Silvio Berlusconi's Fininvest SpA media empire, did not nominate a fourth managing director to replace Ubaldo Livolsi.
Livolsi remains a Mediaset director but will concentrate on his role as managing director of Fininvest.
A company statement said Adreani would be responsible for publicity, Bernasconi for cinematographic and television rights and Galliani for broadcasting and new iniatives.
